messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shiny deployment out of memory but all the files are less than 1GB limit
parts: If your data when loaded is more than your instance type allows then you will see this out of memory error. If your subscription plan allows, try a larger instance type. Otherwise you will need to process the data more memory efficiently.

On Wednesday, February 28, 2018 at 8:44:56 AM UTC-5, Melvin86 wrote:
edit: file size is the size of the .rds file. When I decompress them in R the size seems really bigger than 1GB. Do you think is for this reason?
